observations: A roughly square head mass sits on a flat purple ground; the left side carries dense red and black scribble loops where an eye socket might be, while the right side holds a spiral of white lines tightening toward a red-centered yellow ring.

A wide mouth near the lower center shows white teeth rendered with short parallel marks; blue strokes cut diagonally across the chin and cheek, contrasting with the warm ochre and brown base tones of the head.
Orange and magenta blobs extend beyond the head outline at left and right edges; a cluster of white looping lines fans outward from the upper-right corner, separate from the head mass.
reading: The head fills most of the frame, its two sides handled differently: the left buried under layered scribble, the right opened by a tight spiral drawing the eye toward a red dot. That asymmetry creates a lopsided pressure across the image. The bared teeth and the unresolved left socket read as tension held rather than released. The flat purple ground contains the whole form without softening it.
